title: Autofarm, Deliver, Ingredients, Clean, Shop, Pan Stealers
features:
🍽️ RESTAURANT AUTOMATION

New features v1.0.41:
- Added Leaderboard
- Added Auto Rarity:
If on it will allow some Common customers also when no queue
- Fixed panning stealers
- Added Auto Unlock for unlocking tables - only at night time

Not A Bug:
Panning customers will not work if player is already holding a dish.


----------------------------------------------

Auto Assign Customers

Automatically opens the counter and seats customers at available tables.

You can set a minimum customer rarity to skip lower-tier customers. The default is None, which accepts everyone.

The system checks for an available table before assigning a customer.

If assignments happen too quickly, turn on the delay to give the server time to update.

---

🍔 Auto Deliver Orders

Automatically picks up finished dishes from the kitchen and delivers them to customers.

After delivering, it returns to the counter.

Works across multiple floors automatically.

You can adjust the delivery speed with the Serve Delay setting.

---

🧽 Auto Wash Dishes

Automatically washes dishes when the sink is full.

It won't interrupt food deliveries and will wait until you're finished serving.

---

🛒 Auto Buy Ingredients

Automatically goes to the Grocery Store and restocks your ingredients when supplies get low.

Set the percentage at which you want it to restock.

It buys all available ingredient types at once.

You need at least 100 pesos for a restock.

Keep this OFF while farming or it may keep teleporting you away.

---

🧹 Auto Clean

Automatically cleans trash from your restaurant and the main trash area.

Runs in the background, so you don't have to keep checking it.

---

🪑 FURNITURE SHOP

How It Works

Choose the furniture categories you want, then press Refresh to see what's currently in stock.

You can select multiple categories at once.

Auto-Watch & Buy

1. Press Refresh to load the current stock.
2. Select the items you want to watch.
3. Turn on Auto-Watch & Buy.
4. Choose how often it checks the shop.
5. When an item comes back in stock, it buys it automatically.

For rare or expensive items, use Buy Selected Items (Once) instead to avoid buying multiple copies.

---

🏃 PLAYER UTILITIES

Walk Speed

Increase your movement speed from the normal speed up to 150 studs/sec.

Higher speeds can look suspicious, so use them carefully.

NoClip

Walk through walls and other objects.

Humanoid Walk looks more natural than teleporting around.

Teleports

Quickly move to useful locations like:

* Counter
* Kitchen
* Sink
* Drink Chiller
* Mystery Box
* Merchant
* Trash Spawner

Anti-AFK

Prevents you from being kicked for being inactive.

Server Hop

Finds less crowded servers when you want a quieter server.

Trash ESP

Highlights trash locations so you can easily find and collect them.

---

⚠️ IMPORTANT TIPS

* Don't leave automation running overnight. Bugs can cause unwanted loops or purchases.
* Keep an eye on your cash when using Auto Buy Ingredients.
* If Auto Assign seems stuck, check your customer rarity filter.
* Humanoid Walk looks more natural than Teleport movement.
* NoClip can interfere with food deliveries. Turn it off while serving if deliveries stop working.
* Be careful with Auto-Watch & Buy. It can purchase an item again every time the shop restocks.
* Use Buy Once for rare or expensive furniture when you only want one.
